other_conditions: The student must be a permanent resident of Odisha State
Parental income from all sources must not exceed ₹6,00,000 per annum
The student must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in the previous qualifying examination
Applicants can apply only in the first year of the course (year of joining)
Eligible courses include recognized UG, PG, and Technical & Professional degree programs as specified in the scheme guidelines
benefits_summary: Scholarship provides up to ₹20,000 per student per year, payable as a one-time amount for the total duration of the course.
